en.name: Divisibility of a sum
en.message: If d divides a and b, it divides a+b.

zh.name: 整除的加法封闭性
zh.message: 若 d 整除 a 与 b，则 d 整除 a+b。

en.name: Subtract the remainder
en.message: For integers a,d with d≠0, a−(a mod d) is an integer multiple of d.

zh.name: 被除数减去余数
zh.message: 对整数 a、d 且 d≠0，a−(a mod d) 是 d 的整数倍。

en.name: Divisibility of factorials
en.message: For natural numbers m≤n, m! divides n!, since the remaining factors have an integer product.

zh.name: 阶乘的整除关系
zh.message: 对自然数 m≤n，m! 整除 n!，因为剩余因子的乘积为整数。

en.name: Greatest common divisor divides its inputs
en.message: The nonzero greatest common divisor gcd(a,b) divides each of the integers a and b.

zh.name: 最大公约数整除两个参数
zh.message: 非零最大公约数 gcd(a,b) 整除整数 a、b 中的每一个。

en.name: A common divisor divides the greatest common divisor
en.message: A positive integer d dividing a and b also divides gcd(a,b).

zh.name: 公约数整除最大公约数
zh.message: 正整数 d 若同时整除 a 与 b，则 d 整除 gcd(a,b)。

en.name: Inputs divide their least common multiple
en.message: For nonzero integers a,b, |a| and |b| each divide lcm(a,b).

zh.name: 两个参数整除最小公倍数
zh.message: 对非零整数 a、b，|a| 与 |b| 分别整除 lcm(a,b)。

en.name: Least common multiple divides every common multiple

zh.name: 最小公倍数整除公倍数
zh.message: 对正整数 a、b，它们的任意公倍数 m 都被 lcm(a,b) 整除。

en.name: Divisibility of a linear combination
en.message: If d divides a and b, it divides u·a+v·b for all integers u,v.

zh.name: 整除整数线性组合
zh.message: 若 d 整除 a 与 b，则对任意整数 u、v，d 整除 u·a+v·b。

en.name: One divides every integer
en.message: For any integer a, a=1·a, so 1 divides a. For example, $dvd(6, 1).

zh.name: 一整除任意整数
zh.message: 对任意整数 a，a=1·a，因此 1 整除 a。例如 $dvd(6, 1)。

en.name: A factor divides its product

zh.name: 因子整除乘积

en.name: Divisibility of an integer multiple

zh.name: 整除保持整数倍

en.name: A nonzero integer divides itself

zh.name: 非零整数整除自身

en.name: Divisibility of a difference

zh.name: 整除的减法封闭性

en.name: Every nonzero integer divides zero

zh.name: 非零整数整除零

zh.name: 整数闭区间的穷尽分类

en.name: Excluded middle

zh.name: 排中律

en.name: Complete residue classes

zh.name: 完整余数分类

zh.name: 非严格不等式的分类

en.name: Complementary real orders

zh.name: 实数序的互补关系

zh.name: 整数序的离散性

en.name: Integer interval and tail

zh.name: 整数的有限分类与尾部
